common_rules.mandatory_disclosure: If the reported effect exists only in the selected representative instance, that fact must be reported explicitly and may not be hidden.

reporting_contract.appendix: Publish the complete 80-instance table with no omitted row.
reporting_contract.effect_only_selected_sentence_required: If stability checks show that an effect occurs only in cn-cy-100c-01-V2-LOCATIONS, write exactly that substantive fact in the results and discussion; do not suppress it.
reporting_contract.main_text: Show the frozen representative instance only; state that it was selected before new experiments by selection_rule.json and give its hash.
reporting_contract.stability_summary: For every block, summarize all 80 instance-level outcomes as improve/tie/regress/infeasible-or-not-found counts plus median and interquartile range.
